name: Device Diagnostics Report
description: Collect firmware stats, browser details and dashboard feature checks into a downloadable diagnostic report.
author: Tavros Baker
code:
const root=document.querySelector('#xp-plugin-'+"tavros.device-diagnostics-report"+' .xp-workshop-content');if(!root)throw Error('Plugin panel missing');root.innerHTML="
";let report=null;root.querySelector('[data-run]').onclick=async()=>{report={created:new Date().toISOString(),browser:{userAgent:navigator.userAgent,language:navigator.language,online:navigator.onLine},dashboard:{version:xlinkWorkshop.version,sections:['controller','cheats','macros','console','settings','workshop'].map(id=>({id,found:!!document.getElementById(id)}))}};try{report.device=await xlink.status()}catch(e){report.deviceError=e.message}root.querySelector('[data-out]').textContent=JSON.stringify(report,null,2);root.querySelector('[data-save]').disabled=false};root.querySelector('[data-save]').onclick=()=>report&&xlink.download('xlinkpro-diagnostics.json',JSON.stringify(report,null,2));return()=>root.replaceChildren();
